s.note: Ginny's wedding, the reason everyone forgot
s.how: Line a 12-hole tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream, add 80g diced ham and chives, fill and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Top thick cucumber rounds with 150g smoked salmon.

s.note: he's having a very big night
s.how: Fry 24 frozen pork dumplings flat side down in a little oil until golden. Add 100ml water, cover and steam 4 minutes. Uncover and crisp again. Mix soy and black vinegar with sliced spring onion to dip.

m.note: the reception after the very strange wedding
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs. Add 250g mushrooms, thyme and 200ml white wine and braise 35 minutes, then stir in 100ml cream. Cook 300g long grain rice with a knob of butter and 600ml stock for pilaf.

w.note: make a wish over it, finally
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Blitz 150g strawberries and beat into 250g butter with 450g icing sugar. Fill, cover and add exactly sixteen candles.

d.note: the punch bowl at the dance
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice and 250ml cranberry juice into a punch bowl with ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and float a sliced orange on top. Ladle into cups.
